command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/g4")
summary=json.loads((root/"range-debug-summary.json").read_text())
expected=list(range(27))
assert summary["status"]=="passed" and summary["errors"]==[] and summary["num_layers"]==27
assert summary["prefill"]=={"commit_event_count":1,"event_count":28,"range_event_count":27,"range_layers":expected,"whole_key_event_count":0}
assert summary["decode"]=={"commit_event_count":0,"event_count":27,"range_event_count":27,"range_layers":expected,"whole_key_event_count":0}
response=json.loads((root/"response.json").read_text())
assert len(response["choices"])==1 and response["choices"][0]["text"] and response["choices"][0]["finish_reason"]=="length"
assert response["usage"]["prompt_tokens"]==525 and response["usage"]["completion_tokens"]==16 and response["usage"]["total_tokens"]==541
assert (root/"http-status.txt").read_text().strip()=="200"
for role in ("prefill","decode"):
    log=(root/f"vllm-{role}.log").read_text()
    assert log.count('POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1" 200 OK')==1
    assert "TypeError" not in log and "Traceback (most recent call last)" not in log
    events=[]
    for line in log.splitlines():
        if "[KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG]" in line:
            events.append(json.loads(line.split("[KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG]",1)[1].strip()))
    ranges=[event for event in events if event["event"]=="range"]
    assert len(ranges)==27 and sorted(event["layer_id"] for event in ranges)==expected
    for event in ranges:
        assert event["key_count"]==4
        assert len(event["sizes"])==len(event["requested_bytes"])==len(event["results"])==4
        for sizes,requested,result in zip(event["sizes"],event["requested_bytes"],event["results"]):
            assert requested==sum(sizes)==result and result>0
assert "kvpool hit tokens: 512, need to load: 512" in (root/"vllm-decode.log").read_text()
metrics=(root/"post-request.metrics").read_text()
values={}
for name in ("master_key_count","master_allocated_bytes","master_active_clients","master_batch_put_start_requests_total","master_batch_put_end_requests_total"):
    match=re.search(rf"^{name} ([0-9.eE+-]+)$",metrics,re.M); assert match; values[name]=float(match.group(1))
assert values["master_key_count"]==4 and values["master_allocated_bytes"]==15925248 and values["master_active_clients"]==2 and values["master_batch_put_start_requests_total"]==1 and values["master_batch_put_end_requests_total"]==1,values
assert (root/"prefill-debug-env.txt").read_text().strip()=="VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG=1" and (root/"decode-debug-env.txt").read_text().strip()=="VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG=1"
